Download the application form from the official website: www.mumbaiport.gov.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chief Manager (ICT) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form for the Chief Manager (ICT) position at Mumbai Port Authority is 04 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Manager (ICT) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Manager (ICT) position as per the official recruitment notification released by the Mumbai Port Authority.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Chief Manager (ICT) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chief Manager (ICT) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 2,00,000/- on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Mumbai Port Authority recruitment is offline. Candidates must send their filled application forms via post to the specified address in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Chief Manager (ICT) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Chief Manager (ICT) position is 55 years as per the eligibility criteria mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a First Class Graduate degree in B.E or B. Tech in Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology, or a specialization in a relevant field of IT.

faq.question: Q7. How many years of experience are required for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have at least 12 years of experience in the executive cadre in fields like Programming, EDP, Network, or System Design and Analysis in an industrial or commercial organization.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to: The Manager (HR), Mumbai Port Authority, General Administration Department, Port House, 2nd Floor, Shoorji Vallabhdas Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai – 400001.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Chief Manager (ICT) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on the eligibility criteria followed by a personal interview to assess the candidate's suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Chief Manager (ICT) recruitment at Mumbai Port Authority.
